full_prompt_en: A vertical palette-knife oil painting fills a narrow central panel with a crowded bouquet of poppies. Broad cup-shaped blossoms face in different directions, their petals built from thick strokes of butter yellow, orange, scarlet, lilac, magenta, violet, and pale mint. Dark centers sit inside several open flowers, giving the bright color a steady rhythm of small black anchors. The upper half is densely packed with overlapping blooms against a fiery red-orange ground; toward the bottom, long slender stems descend through blue-green and yellow paint. A large golden flower near the upper right catches the strongest light, while a lavender blossom to its left provides a cool counterweight. Lower orange and purple flowers overlap a deep teal base, their petals streaked with fine light lines that reveal the direction of each knife mark. Black vertical margins frame the painted panel, making its saturated center even more intense. The flowers are recognizable, yet their individual edges break into adjacent color rather than staying botanically exact. Opaque ridges, scraped transitions, and little exposed underlayers make the surface visibly physical. Light is created largely by the warm petals against darker cool stems, without a single realistic illumination source. The whole frame feels exuberant and compressed, like a burst of floral color held between dark borders.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅竖向的调色刀油画在狭长中央画板里填满拥挤的罂粟花束。宽大的杯形花朵朝向不同方向，花瓣由奶黄、橙色、猩红、淡紫、洋红、紫罗兰和浅薄荷色的厚笔触构成。几朵盛开的花有深色花心，让明亮色彩以细小黑点形成稳定节奏。上半部的花朵彼此紧密重叠，映在火热红橙色底上；向下，细长茎秆穿过蓝绿色和黄色颜料。一朵靠右上方的大金色花接住最强光，左边淡紫花提供冷色平衡。下方橙色与紫色花朵叠在深青色底前，花瓣上的细亮线显示每一道刀痕的方向。黑色竖向边框围住彩绘画板，让饱和中央更显强烈。花朵可以辨认，但各自边缘破碎、融进邻近色彩，不追求植物学精确。厚实不透明的颜料脊、刮开的过渡与少量露出的底层，让表面有可见的物理质地。光主要由暖花瓣对较暗冷色茎叶产生，而非来自单一写实光源。整幅画像被深色边框夹住的一次花色迸发，欢腾而紧凑。
style_prompt_en: The palette-knife oil image piles opaque saturated color into a narrow vertical field bounded by dark margins. Large cup-like curved planes overlap tightly above long thin lower strokes. Butter yellow, orange, scarlet, lilac, magenta, violet, and mint erupt against red and deep teal, while small near-black centers keep the chromatic rhythm grounded. Thick ridges, scraped color transitions, and glimpses of underpainting make the surface physically active. Bright petals are built from directional streaks rather than smooth gradients; surrounding edges often merge into adjacent paint. The upper area is dense and warm, the lower area cooler and more linear. Illumination comes from the juxtaposition of high-value pigment with dark recesses rather than an external light source. The whole frame feels exuberant, tactile, and compressed through fearless color area and visible knife movement.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅调色刀油画把不透明的饱和色彩堆在由深色边缘围住的狭长竖向区域里。大而呈杯形的弯曲平面在上方紧密重叠，下方延伸为细长笔迹。奶黄、橙色、猩红、淡紫、洋红、紫罗兰和薄荷色在红色与深青色前爆开，小小近黑色中心让色彩节奏有所依托。厚颜料脊、刮擦式色彩过渡和偶尔露出的底层，使表面在物理意义上活跃。明亮花瓣由带方向的条纹建立，而非平滑渐变；周围边缘常融入邻近颜料。上部密集而温暖，下部更冷、更有线性。照明来自高明度颜料与深色凹处的并置，而非外部光源。整幅画凭大胆的色彩面积和可见的刀具运动，显得欢腾、可触而紧凑。
theme_en: A dense bouquet of vivid poppies
name: Abstract D'Oyley
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
